استلمن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَلَمْنَ (istalamna) /is.ta.lam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اُسْتُلِمْنَ (ustulimna) /us.tu.lim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اِسْتَلِمْنَ (istalimna) /is.ta.lim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
